name: @anonrouter/client
description: Thin, dependency-free JS client for AnonRouter's public API (plaintext / TEE / private routes). For content AnonRouter must never see, use @anonrouter/confidential.
author: AnonRouter
//prepare: The confidential package's route-matrix example imports this one, and npm resolves that import through `types` -> dist. Building on install means a fresh clone can typecheck before anything has been built by hand; without it `npm ci && npm run typecheck` fails on a file nobody edited.
